title: Exoticious Staff
description: A powerful staff/admin plugin featuring vanish, admin mode, freeze, custom staff tags, and more.
body:
# ExoticiousStaff

A feature-rich staff and admin management plugin designed for server operators. Give your staff team the tools they need to manage players effectively.

---

## 📋 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/heal` | Heals you to full health and hunger |
| `/vanish` | Toggle vanish — broadcasts fake leave/join messages to other players |
| `/admin` | Toggle admin mode with special tools |
| `/freeze <player>` | Freeze or unfreeze a player in place |
| `/invsee <player>` | View and edit another player's inventory |
| `/broadcast <message>` | Send a highlighted announcement to all players |
| `/speed <0-10>` | Set your walk or fly speed |
| `/fly [player]` | Toggle fly for yourself or another player |
| `/day` | Set the time to day |
| `/night` | Set the time to night |
| `/staff <player> <tag> <color> <neon/normal> <bold/normal>` | Give a player a custom staff tag |
| `/staff <player> remove` | Remove a player's staff tag |

---

## 🎮 Admin Mode
Type `/admin` to swap into a fresh admin inventory with 4 special tools:

- 🧭 **Compass** — Toggle spectator mode
- ⭐ **Nether Star** — Toggle creative mode
- 💎 **Diamond** — Summon diamond ore at your location
- ⬛ **Netherite Ingot** — Summon ancient debris at your location

Your original inventory is automatically saved and restored when you exit admin mode. If you disconnect while in admin mode your inventory will be fully restored on your next login.

---

## 🏷️ Staff Tags
Give players custom colored tags that appear in the tab list.

**Usage:**

**Available colors:**
`red` `blue` `green` `yellow` `purple` `pink` `white` `gray` `gold` `aqua` `black` `darkred` `darkblue` `darkgreen` `darkaqua` `darkgray`

Each color can be set to `neon` or `normal` and `bold` or `normal`.

---

## 👁️ Vanish
When you vanish, other players will see a fake leave message. When you unvanish, they will see a fake join message. You remain fully invisible until you toggle it off.

---

## 🧊 Freeze
Freeze any online player in place. They will not be able to move until you unfreeze them. Use `/freeze <player>` again to unfreeze.

---

## 🔒 Permissions
All permissions default to **OP only**.

| Permission | Command |
|---|---|
| `exoticious.heal` | `/heal` |
| `exoticious.vanish` | `/vanish` |
| `exoticious.admin` | `/admin` |
| `exoticious.freeze` | `/freeze` |
| `exoticious.invsee` | `/invsee` |
| `exoticious.broadcast` | `/broadcast` |
| `exoticious.speed` | `/speed` |
| `exoticious.fly` | `/fly` |
| `exoticious.time` | `/day` `/night` |
| `exoticious.staff` | `/staff` |~~~~

---

<details>
<summary>🚀 Installation</summary>

1. **Download** the `ExoticiousStaff.jar`
2. **Drop it** into your server's `/plugins` folder
3. **Restart** the server
4. **Use any command instantly** — no setup required

**No config files. No setup. No extra permissions needed.**

</details>

<details>
<summary>🧠 How It Works</summary>

ExoticiousStaff is a lightweight all-in-one staff plugin. Everything works out of the box the moment you install it. All commands are OP-only by default so your staff can get to work immediately without any configuration.

- Admin mode saves your inventory to a file so it **never gets lost** even if you disconnect
- Vanish sends **fake leave and join messages** so players never know you're there
- Staff tags show up **instantly in the tab list** for all online players
- Freeze **locks players in place** server-side so they cannot escape

</details>
